data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jaya', meaning 'victorious'. historical_references.reference: Jayinee was a legendary figure in ancient Indian literature, known for her exceptional beauty and wisdom. She is believed to have been the queen of the celestial king Indra and is often depicted as an embodiment of feminine grace and power.

historical_references.reference: Jayinee is also the name of a queen mentioned in the Indian epic Mahabharata. She was the wife of the Pandava prince Bhima and is known for her role in helping the Pandavas regain their kingdom after the great Kurukshetra war.

This name is gaining popularity not only in India but also worldwide due to the increasing globalization of Indian culture. 'Jayinee' is a unique and beautiful name that can be found on various social media platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok. On LinkedIn, it can be seen on the profiles of professionals with Indian origins. On Instagram, it is used as a hashtag for posts related to Indian culture and fashion. On TikTok, it is used as a username by creators who make videos showcasing their Indian heritage. Overall, 'Jayinee' is a name that represents the rich cultural heritage of India while also being modern and unique.
